shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I currently have equal amounts of B, C, and A (1 each). Trading away my only A for another B would make me have 2 B and 0 A, reducing variety and hurting my utility since I value variety across goods equally.

I'd rather keep my balanced bundle or trade for something that increases variety, not swap one single good for another when both are already at parity.
